sanskrit_iast: tat sāmidhenībhiḥ pūrva pakṣa apara pakṣāv āpnoti |
meaning: तत् सामिधेनीभिः पूर्व पक्ष अपर पक्षाव् आप्नोति |

sanskrit_iast: vajreṇa eva tad yajamānasya pāpmānam hanti |
meaning: वज्रेण एव तद् यजमानस्य पाप्मानम् हन्ति |

sanskrit_iast: yad v eva triḥ prathamām triru uttamām |
meaning: यद् व् एव त्रिः प्रथमाम् त्रिरु उत्तमाम् |

sanskrit_iast: yajñasya eva tad barsau nahyati sthemne avisraṃsāya |
meaning: यज्ञस्य एव तद् बर्सौ नह्यति स्थेम्ने अविस्रंसाय |

sanskrit_iast: tāsām vai trīṇi ṣaṣṭi śatāny akṣarāṇām bhavanti |
meaning: तासाम् वै त्रीणि षष्टि शतान्य् अक्षराणाम् भवन्ति |

sanskrit_iast: trīṇi vai ṣaṣṭi śatāni saṃvatsarasya ahnām |
meaning: त्रीणि वै षष्टि शतानि संवत्सरस्य अह्नाम् |

sanskrit_iast: svena eva tat chandasā agnim stauti |
meaning: स्वेन एव तत् छन्दसा अग्निम् स्तौति |

sanskrit_iast: yad yajñe abhirūpam tat samṛddham yajñasya eva samṛddhyai |
meaning: यद् यज्ञे अभिरूपम् तत् समृद्धम् यज्ञस्य एव समृद्ध्यै |

sanskrit_iast: uttamāyai tṛtīye vacane praṇavena nigadam upasaṃdadhāti |
meaning: उत्तमायै तृतीये वचने प्रणवेन निगदम् उपसंदधाति |

sanskrit_iast: agne mahān asi brāhmaṇa bhārata iti |
meaning: अग्ने महान् असि ब्राह्मण भारत इति |

sanskrit_iast: na ha vā anārṣeyasya devā havir aśnanti |
meaning: न ह वा अनार्षेयस्य देवा हविर् अश्नन्ति |

sanskrit_iast: atha etam pañcadaśa padam nigadam upasaṃdadhāti |
meaning: अथ एतम् पञ्चदश पदम् निगदम् उपसंदधाति |

sanskrit_iast: dvayam vā idam sarvam chandas kṛtam ca acchandas kṛtam ca |
meaning: द्वयम् वा इदम् सर्वम् छन्दस् कृतम् च अच्छन्दस् कृतम् च |

text: In that he summons the deities severally, it is because the oblations are taken separately for them. In that he summons Agni through Agni, the form of Agni which bears the oblation is his sacrificial form. It is what there over yonder sun shines like light; therefore the sun (appears) to every man. Thus in that he says ‘O Agni bring Agni’, verily thus he says ‘That (form) bring.’ In that he invites the gods that drink the butter, thus he invites the fore-offerings and the after-offerings. In that he invites Agni for the Hotṛ's function, thus he invites the Sviṣṭakṛt (offering). In that he invites his own greatness, thus he invites Vāyu; Agni's own greatness is Vāyu, for by him he acquires and attains greatness. In that he recites by order, and sacrifices by order, thereby verily sacrifice is made to his own greatness. ‘Bring, O All-knower, and offer with good sacrifice’, (with these words) he says to him, ‘Bring the gods, O All-knower, and offer to the gods with good sacrifice.’ In that he mutters before the kindling verses, and the kindling verses are a thunderbolt, verily thus he appeases him both before and after. In that he takes up the two ladles with the verse for taking up the ladles, verily thus he yokes a chariot of the gods, being about to bestow the oblation upon the gods. With this chariot of the gods he attains safely the world of heaven.

sanskrit_iast: nānā hy ābhyo havīṃṣi gṛhītāni bhavanti |
meaning: नाना ह्य् आभ्यो हवींषि गृहीतानि भवन्ति |

sanskrit_iast: eṣā vā agner yajñiyā tanūr yā asya havya vāṭ |
meaning: एषा वा अग्नेर् यज्ञिया तनूर् या अस्य हव्य वाट् |

sanskrit_iast: sā vā asau yad ado amuṣyād ity asya upariṣṭād divi iva bhāti jyotir iva |
meaning: सा वा असौ यद् अदो अमुष्याद् इत्य् अस्य उपरिष्टाद् दिवि इव भाति ज्योतिर् इव |

sanskrit_iast: tad yad āha agnim agna āvaha iti |
meaning: तद् यद् आह अग्निम् अग्न आवह इति |

sanskrit_iast: tām āvaha ity eva tad āha |
meaning: ताम् आवह इत्य् एव तद् आह |

sanskrit_iast: yad v eva vācā anvāha vācā yajati |
meaning: यद् व् एव वाचा अन्वाह वाचा यजति |

sanskrit_iast: tena u ha eva asya svo mahimā iṣṭo bhavati |
meaning: तेन उ ह एव अस्य स्वो महिमा इष्टो भवति |

sanskrit_iast: ā ca vaha jātavedaḥ suyujā ca yaja ity āha |
meaning: आ च वह जातवेदः सुयुजा च यज इत्य् आह |

sanskrit_iast: āvaha ca jātavedo devānt sayujā ca devatā yaja ity eva enam tad āha |
meaning: आवह च जातवेदो देवान्त् सयुजा च देवता यज इत्य् एव एनम् तद् आह |

sanskrit_iast: tam eva etat śamayati purastāc ca upariṣṭāc ca |
meaning: तम् एव एतत् शमयति पुरस्ताच् च उपरिष्टाच् च |

sanskrit_iast: atha yat srug ādāpanena srucāv ādāpayati |
meaning: अथ यत् स्रुग् आदापनेन स्रुचाव् आदापयति |

sanskrit_iast: deva ratham eva tad yunakti devebhyo haviḥ pradāsyan |
meaning: देव रथम् एव तद् युनक्ति देवेभ्यो हविः प्रदास्यन् |

sanskrit_iast: sa etena deva rathena svasti svargaṃl lokam samaśnute |
meaning: स एतेन देव रथेन स्वस्ति स्वर्गंल् लोकम् समश्नुते |

text:
He offers the fore-offerings. The fore-offerings are the seasons; verily thus he delights the seasons. They are five; with them he obtains whatever there is fivefold pertaining to the self or to the gods. He offers to the kindling sticks; verily (thus he delights) the spring; in the spring all
this is kindled. He offers to Tanūnapāt; verily (thus he delights) the hot season, for the hot season heats the body. He offers to the sacrificial food; verily (thus he delights) the rains, for through the rains sacrificial food arises. He offers to the strew; verily (thus he delights) the autumn, for in the autumn the plants on the strew grow best. He offers at the end to the making of Hail!; verily (thus he delights) the winter, for in the winter over all this is Hail! made. They say 'Seeing that there are five fore-offerings and six seasons, where does he offer to the sixth season?' In that in the fourth fore-offering he mingles (the butter), thus he gives it a share in the others. Again, in that in the last fore-offering he mixes together the gods, he makes them sharers in the fore-offerings. Just as Agni has a share in all oblations, so he makes the deities sharers in the share of Agni. He does not say here 'Agni from the Hotṛ's office' (thinking), 'The fore-offerings are cattle; the Sviṣṭakṛt is Rudra; let me not bring the cattle of the sacrifice into contact with Rudra.' Some say 'Hail! May the gods, drinking the butter, rejoicing, O Agni, enjoy this butter.' He should not so do. The butter is one half of the sacrifice, the oblation is the other half; if he were to say one only of these, then one half of the sacrifice would have an accompaniment, the other half not. Therefore he should say 'Hail! May the gods, drinking the butter, rejoicing, O Agni, enjoy this butter, this oblation.'

sanskrit_iast: tair yat kiṃca pañca vidham adhidaivatam adhyātmam tat sarvam āpnoti |
meaning: तैर् यत् किंच पञ्च विधम् अधिदैवतम् अध्यात्मम् तत् सर्वम् आप्नोति |

sanskrit_iast: varṣābhir hi īḍitam anna adyam uttiṣṭhati |
meaning: वर्षाभिर् हि ईडितम् अन्न अद्यम् उत्तिष्ठति |

sanskrit_iast: svāhā kṛtim antam yajati hemantam eva |
meaning: स्वाहा कृतिम् अन्तम् यजति हेमन्तम् एव |

sanskrit_iast: hemante vā idam sarvam svāhā kṛtam |
meaning: हेमन्ते वा इदम् सर्वम् स्वाहा कृतम् |

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur yat pañca prayājāḥ ṣaḍ ṛtavaḥ kvaitam ṣaṣṭham ṛtum yajati iti |
meaning: तद् आहुर् यत् पञ्च प्रयाजाः षड् ऋतवः क्वैतम् षष्ठम् ऋतुम् यजति इति |

sanskrit_iast: yad eva caturthe prayāje samānayati tad enam itareṣv anuvibhajati |
meaning: यद् एव चतुर्थे प्रयाजे समानयति तद् एनम् इतरेष्व् अनुविभजति |

sanskrit_iast: atha yad uttame prayāje devatāḥ samāvapati |
meaning: अथ यद् उत्तमे प्रयाजे देवताः समावपति |

sanskrit_iast: prayāja bhāja eva enās tat karoti |
meaning: प्रयाज भाज एव एनास् तत् करोति |

sanskrit_iast: tad yathā agniḥ sarveṣu havihṣu bhāgī bhavati |
meaning: तद् यथा अग्निः सर्वेषु हविह्षु भागी भवति |

sanskrit_iast: evam tad agner bhāge devatā bhāginīḥ karoti |
meaning: एवम् तद् अग्नेर् भागे देवता भागिनीः करोति |

sanskrit_iast: na atra agnim hotrād ity āha |
meaning: न अत्र अग्निम् होत्राद् इत्य् आह |

sanskrit_iast: na id rudreṇa yajamānasya paśūn prasajāni iti |
meaning: न इद् रुद्रेण यजमानस्य पशून् प्रसजानि इति |

sanskrit_iast: svāhā devā ājyapā juṣāṇā agna ājyasya vyantv iti ha eka āhuḥ |
meaning: स्वाहा देवा आज्यपा जुषाणा अग्न आज्यस्य व्यन्त्व् इति ह एक आहुः |

sanskrit_iast: ardham ha vai yajñasya ājyam ardham haviḥ |
meaning: अर्धम् ह वै यज्ञस्य आज्यम् अर्धम् हविः |

sanskrit_iast: ardham ha vai yajñasya samiṣṭam syād ardham asamiṣṭam |
meaning: अर्धम् ह वै यज्ञस्य समिष्टम् स्याद् अर्धम् असमिष्टम् |

sanskrit_iast: tasmāt svāhā devā ājyapā juṣāṇā agna ājyasya haviṣo vyantv ity eva brūyāt |
meaning: तस्मात् स्वाहा देवा आज्यपा जुषाणा अग्न आज्यस्य हविषो व्यन्त्व् इत्य् एव ब्रूयात् |

sanskrit_iast: atha yat paurṇamāsyām vārtraghnāv ājya bhāgau bhavataḥ |
meaning: अथ यत् पौर्णमास्याम् वार्त्रघ्नाव् आज्य भागौ भवतः |
text:
In that the butter portions at the full moon offering contain references to the slaying of Vṛtra, it is because Indra slew Vṛtra with the full moon offering. In that they have references to growth at the new moon offering, it is because then the moon becomes destroyed and verily thus does he cause it to swell up and to increase The offering verses in these offerings contain the word 'rejoicing', for they include the same oblations as the fore-offerings. Now 'rejoicing' is the holy power; verily thus by the holy power he offers the oblation to the gods. These offerings are threefold, ye yajāmahe, the Nigada, the sound vaṣaṭ; the butter portions
are the eye; the eye is threefold, white, black, and red. These offerings he does not perform in the animal or Soma sacrifice (thinking), 'Through the animal offering the Soma sacrifice is possessed of eyes; let me not make the sacrifice four-eyed and loathsome.' In that the invitatory verses contain the words 'to' and 'offered', and the offering verses the words 'forward', that is, 'given', verily thus having sacrificed he gives the oblation to the gods. These (verses) are Gāyatrī and Triṣṭubh; the Gāyatrī is the holy power; the Triṣṭubh is lordly power; verily thus with the holy and lordly power he gives the oblation to the gods. So great is the extension of the metre; verily thus with the whole extension of the metre he gives the oblation to the gods. At the end of the Ṛc he utters the sound vaṣaṭ; so do all his offering verses become beautiful. With ṣaṭ he utters vaṣaṭ; the seasons are six; verily thus he pleases the seasons. He should utter vaṣaṭ as connected with the Bṛhat and the Rathantara, with a long in front and short behind; the short is the Rathantara, the long the Bṛhat; again, the Rathantara is this (earth); the Bṛhat is yonder (sky); verily thus in these two he finds support. So great is the extension of speech; verily thus with the whole extension of speech he gives the oblation to the gods. 'bhūr bhuvaḥ' he mutters before ye yajāmahe, 'Strength is might, might is strength; light' after the sound vaṣaṭ: the sound vaṣaṭ is a thunderbolt; verily thus he quietens it, both in front and behind. Strength and might are the two most dear forms of the sound vaṣaṭ; verily with them he quietens it.

sanskrit_iast: tam eva etad āpyāyayati tam vardhayati |
meaning: तम् एव एतद् आप्याययति तम् वर्धयति |

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇā eva tad devebhyo haviḥ prayacchati |
meaning: ब्राह्मणा एव तद् देवेभ्यो हविः प्रयच्छति |

sanskrit_iast: trivṛd vai cakṣuḥ śuklam kṛṣṇam lohitam iti |
meaning: त्रिवृद् वै चक्षुः शुक्लम् कृष्णम् लोहितम् इति |

sanskrit_iast: tau na paśau na some karoti |
meaning: तौ न पशौ न सोमे करोति |

sanskrit_iast: na ic catur akṣam bībhatsam adhvaram karavāṇi iti |
meaning: न इच् चतुर् अक्षम् बीभत्सम् अध्वरम् करवाणि इति |

sanskrit_iast: hūtvā eva tad devebhyo haviḥ prayacchati |
meaning: हूत्वा एव तद् देवेभ्यो हविः प्रयच्छति |

sanskrit_iast: brahma kṣatrābhyām eva tad devebhyo haviḥ prayacchati |
meaning: ब्रह्म क्षत्राभ्याम् एव तद् देवेभ्यो हविः प्रयच्छति |

sanskrit_iast: tathā ha asya sarvā yājyā rūpavatyo bhavanti |
meaning: तथा ह अस्य सर्वा याज्या रूपवत्यो भवन्ति |

sanskrit_iast: bārhata rāthantaram vaṣaṭ kuryāt purastād dīrgham upariṣṭādd hrasvam |
meaning: बार्हत राथन्तरम् वषट् कुर्यात् पुरस्ताद् दीर्घम् उपरिष्टाद्द् ह्रस्वम् |

sanskrit_iast: atho iyam vai rathantaram asau bṛhat |
meaning: अथो इयम् वै रथन्तरम् असौ बृहत् |

sanskrit_iast: sarveṇa eva tad vāco vikāreṇa devebhyo haviḥ prayacchati |
meaning: सर्वेण एव तद् वाचो विकारेण देवेभ्यो हविः प्रयच्छति |

sanskrit_iast: bhūr bhuva iti purastād ye yajāmahasya japati |
meaning: भूर् भुव इति पुरस्ताद् ये यजामहस्य जपति |

sanskrit_iast: vaṣaṭ kṛtyā anujapaty ojaḥ sahaḥ saha ojaḥ svar iti |
meaning: वषट् कृत्या अनुजपत्य् ओजः सहः सह ओजः स्वर् इति |

sanskrit_iast: tam eva etat śamayati purastāc ca upariṣṭāc ca |
meaning: तम् एव एतत् शमयति पुरस्ताच् च उपरिष्टाच् च |

sanskrit_iast: atho ete eva vaṣaṭ kārasya prīyatame tanū yad ojaś ca sahaś ca |
meaning: अथो एते एव वषट् कारस्य प्रीयतमे तनू यद् ओजश् च सहश् च |

sanskrit_iast: atha yad agnim prathamam devatānām yajati |
meaning: अथ यद् अग्निम् प्रथमम् देवतानाम् यजति |
text:
In that he offers to Agni first of the deities, and because Agni is the mouth (beginning) of the gods, verily thus at the beginning he delights the gods. Now as to his sacrificing to Agni and Soma at the full moon offering, Agni and Soma were within Vṛtra; with regard to them Indra could not hurl his bolt; for them he arranged the portion at the full moon
sacrifice; the two are offered to inaudibly, and in a higher tone, to prevent sameness. In that he sacrifices inaudibly, thereby he delights Soma; in that (he sacrifices) in a higher tone, thereby (he delights) Agni. In that he sacrifices to Indra and Agni at the new moon sacrifice, it is because Indra and Agni are supports; verily (the offering serves) for a support. In that, mingling, he sacrifices to Indra at the new moon sacrifice, that is the light of the new moon sacrifice, for the moon is not then seen. In that, without mingling, he offers the butter of the inaudible (sacrifice) between the two cakes, it is for preventing sameness. In that, mingling, he offers the butter of the inaudible (sacrifice) in the midst of the milk offering (sāmnāyya), the explanation of that has been given. In that he sacrifices at the end to Agni Sviṣṭakṛt, it is because he gives the oblation to the gods; he who divides out food tastes it himself last. Again Sviṣṭakṛt is Rudra and he enjoys at the end. Therefore to him at the end he sacrifices. In that (offering) the invitatory and offering verses are of the same metre, but the Nigada differs; though this sameness is avoided. After saying vaṣaṭ, he touches water; the waters are healing and medicine; verily thus are healing and medicine produced at the end in the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: tāv indro na aśaknod abhi vajram prahartum |
meaning: ताव् इन्द्रो न अशक्नोद् अभि वज्रम् प्रहर्तुम् |

sanskrit_iast: yad upāṃśu yajati tena somam prīṇāti |
meaning: यद् उपांशु यजति तेन सोमम् प्रीणाति |

sanskrit_iast: atha yat samnayann indram yajati mahā indram vā |
meaning: अथ यत् सम्नयन्न् इन्द्रम् यजति महा इन्द्रम् वा |

sanskrit_iast: atha yad asamnayan puroḍāśāv antareṇa upāṃśv ājyasya yajaty ajāmitāyai |
meaning: अथ यद् असम्नयन् पुरोडाशाव् अन्तरेण उपांश्व् आज्यस्य यजत्य् अजामितायै |

sanskrit_iast: atha yat samnayant sānnāyyasya antareṇa upāṃśv ājyasya yajati tasya uktam brāhmaṇam |
meaning: अथ यत् सम्नयन्त् सान्नाय्यस्य अन्तरेण उपांश्व् आज्यस्य यजति तस्य उक्तम् ब्राह्मणम् |

sanskrit_iast: atha yad agnim sviṣṭakṛtam antato yajati |
meaning: अथ यद् अग्निम् स्विष्टकृतम् अन्ततो यजति |

sanskrit_iast: eṣa ha vai devebhyo haviḥ prayacchati |
meaning: एष ह वै देवेभ्यो हविः प्रयच्छति |

sanskrit_iast: yo vā annam vibhajaty antataḥ sa bhajate |
meaning: यो वा अन्नम् विभजत्य् अन्ततः स भजते |

sanskrit_iast: tasya tac chandasau yājyā puronuvākye nigado vyavaiti |
meaning: तस्य तच् छन्दसौ याज्या पुरोनुवाक्ये निगदो व्यवैति |

sanskrit_iast: śāntir eva eṣā bheṣajam yajñe kriyate |
meaning: शान्तिर् एव एषा भेषजम् यज्ञे क्रियते |

sanskrit_iast: atha yat pradeśinyām iḍāyāḥ pūrvam añjanam adhara oṣṭhe nilimpate |
meaning: अथ यत् प्रदेशिन्याम् इडायाः पूर्वम् अञ्जनम् अधर ओष्ठे निलिम्पते |
text:
In that he smears on the lower lip the first anointing of the sacrificial food on the forefinger, the lower lip is this world, the upper lip is yonder world, what is between the lips is the atmosphere here; therefore in that he eats, verily thus he delights these worlds continuously. In that he invokes the sacrificial food, verily thus he seeks renown among all beings. Again, the sacrificial food is food; verily thus he places food in himself; again the sacrificial food is cattle; verily (the invocation) serves to obtain cattle. On it four times he breathes; all this (universe) is fourfold; verily (it serves) to obtain all this (universe). Again, in that after invoking the sacrificial food he smells it and the sacrificial food is cattle, verily thus he confers cattle upon himself. Again, in that the Adhvaryu makes the cake to sit on the strew, verily thus he delights the fathers. Again, in that he eats the second portion of the sacrificial food with
muttering, and the muttering is the holy power; verily thus with the holy power he appeases it. Again, in that they cleanse themselves on that (part of the strew) where the strainers are, and the waters are healing and medicine, verily thus at the end in the sacrifice are healing and medicine made. Again, in that they bring up the mess of food, it is because the new and full moon sacrifices have that as the sacrificial fees; therefore they bring up the mess of food. Again, in that he addresses the kindling stick, it is because it alone is left over of the kindling fuel; therefore he celebrates it.

sanskrit_iast: atha yad oṣṭhāv antareṇa tad idam antarikṣam |
meaning: अथ यद् ओष्ठाव् अन्तरेण तद् इदम् अन्तरिक्षम् |

sanskrit_iast: imān eva tal lokān anusaṃtanvan prīṇāti |
meaning: इमान् एव तल् लोकान् अनुसंतन्वन् प्रीणाति |

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣv eva tad bhūteṣu upahavam icchate |
meaning: सर्वेष्व् एव तद् भूतेषु उपहवम् इच्छते |

sanskrit_iast: pāṅkto vai yajño yajñasya eva āptyai |
meaning: पाङ्क्तो वै यज्ञो यज्ञस्य एव आप्त्यै |

sanskrit_iast: atha yaj japena utttara iḍām prāśnāti |
meaning: अथ यज् जपेन उत्त्तर इडाम् प्राश्नाति |

sanskrit_iast: atha yad adhvaryur barhiṣadam puroḍāśam karoti |
meaning: अथ यद् अध्वर्युर् बर्हिषदम् पुरोडाशम् करोति |

sanskrit_iast: śāntir eva eṣā bheṣajam yajñe kriyate |
meaning: शान्तिर् एव एषा भेषजम् यज्ञे क्रियते |

sanskrit_iast: etad dakṣiṇau vai darśa pūrṇa māsau |
meaning: एतद् दक्षिणौ वै दर्श पूर्ण मासौ |

sanskrit_iast: idhmasya vā eṣā eka atiśiṣṭā bhavati |
meaning: इध्मस्य वा एषा एक अतिशिष्टा भवति |

text:
In that he offers three after-offerings, and these worlds are three, verily thus he obtains these worlds. In that he says all last, and the Sviṣṭakṛt is a support, verily (it serves) for a support. In that he says the Sūktavāka, and the Sūktavāka is a support, verily (it serves) for a support. In that he makes mention of earth and sky, and earth and sky are supports, verily (it serves) for a support. Some say 'Agni hath rejoiced in this oblation'. This he should not do; the deity to whom he is sacrificing comes forward thinking 'It is a renewed sacrifice; again will he give me the oblation', and takes away the blessings of the sacrificer; therefore 'He hath rejoiced in oblation, he hath rejoiced in oblation' only should he say. The deities to whom he sacrifices in the beginning, verily in the end through them he finds support. In that in the Sūktavāka he mentions the name of the sacrificer, it is because it is the divine self of the sacrificer which the priests make ready; therefore he mentions his name; for here is he born. He should mention it aloud, even if he be a teacher; thus is the sacrificer not likely to fall into ruin. Five blessings he utters; there are three in the sacrificial food; they make up eight; by them the gods attained all attainments (iṣṭiḥ); verily thus does the sacrificer by means of them attain all attainments. Having placed his clasped hands pointing east on the strew he mutters 'For homage', for the gods are not superior to homage. In that he says the Śaṁyuvāka, and the Śaṁyuvāka is a support, verily (it serves) for a support; again Śaṁyu Bārhaspatya appeased all sacrifices; therefore he utters the Śaṁyuvāka.
In that he touches the waters, and the waters are healing and medicine, verily thus at the end in the sacrifice are healing and medicine produced.

sanskrit_iast: pratiṣṭhā vai sūkta vākaḥ pratiṣṭhityā eva |
meaning: प्रतिष्ठा वै सूक्त वाकः प्रतिष्ठित्या एव |

sanskrit_iast: pratiṣṭhe vai dyāvā pṛthivī pratiṣṭhityā eva |
meaning: प्रतिष्ठे वै द्यावा पृथिवी प्रतिष्ठित्या एव |

sanskrit_iast: agnir idam havir ajuṣata iti ha eka āhuḥ |
meaning: अग्निर् इदम् हविर् अजुषत इति ह एक आहुः |

sanskrit_iast: abhyāvartate ha asya devatā punar yajña iti manvānā |
meaning: अभ्यावर्तते ह अस्य देवता पुनर् यज्ञ इति मन्वाना |

sanskrit_iast: sā yajamānasya āśiṣo nivartayati ya idam havir ity āha |
meaning: सा यजमानस्य आशिषो निवर्तयति य इदम् हविर् इत्य् आह |

sanskrit_iast: tasmādd havir ajuṣata havir ajuṣata ity eva brūyāt |
meaning: तस्माद्द् हविर् अजुषत हविर् अजुषत इत्य् एव ब्रूयात् |

sanskrit_iast: atho yā eva etad devatāḥ purastād yajati |
meaning: अथो या एव एतद् देवताः पुरस्ताद् यजति |

sanskrit_iast: atha yat sūkta vāke yajamānasya nāma gṛhṇāti |
meaning: अथ यत् सूक्त वाके यजमानस्य नाम गृह्णाति |

sanskrit_iast: eṣa ha vai daiva ātmā yajamānasya yam ṛtvijaḥ saṃskurvanti |
meaning: एष ह वै दैव आत्मा यजमानस्य यम् ऋत्विजः संस्कुर्वन्ति |

sanskrit_iast: uccair gṛhṇīyād yady apy ācāryaḥ syāt |
meaning: उच्चैर् गृह्णीयाद् यद्य् अप्य् आचार्यः स्यात् |

sanskrit_iast: atha pañca āśiṣo vadata iḍāyām tisras tā aṣṭau |
meaning: अथ पञ्च आशिषो वदत इडायाम् तिस्रस् ता अष्टौ |

sanskrit_iast: etābhir vai devāḥ sarvā aṣṭīr aśnuvata |
meaning: एताभिर् वै देवाः सर्वा अष्टीर् अश्नुवत |

sanskrit_iast: tatho eva etad yajamāna etābhir eva sarvā aṣṭīr aśnute |
meaning: तथो एव एतद् यजमान एताभिर् एव सर्वा अष्टीर् अश्नुते |

sanskrit_iast: atha barhiṣi prāñcam añjalim nidhāya japati nama upa iti |
meaning: अथ बर्हिषि प्राञ्चम् अञ्जलिम् निधाय जपति नम उप इति |

sanskrit_iast: na hi namas kāram ati devāḥ |
meaning: न हि नमस् कारम् अति देवाः |

sanskrit_iast: pratiṣṭhā vai śamyor vākaḥ pratiṣṭhityā eva |
meaning: प्रतिष्ठा वै शम्योर् वाकः प्रतिष्ठित्या एव |

sanskrit_iast: atho śamyur ha vai bārhaspatyaḥ sarvān yajñān śamayām cakāra |
meaning: अथो शम्युर् ह वै बार्हस्पत्यः सर्वान् यज्ञान् शमयाम् चकार |

sanskrit_iast: śāntir eva eṣā bheṣajam yajñe kriyate |
meaning: शान्तिर् एव एषा भेषजम् यज्ञे क्रियते |

sanskrit_iast: atha yad gārhapatye patnī samyājaiś caranti |
meaning: अथ यद् गार्हपत्ये पत्नी सम्याजैश् चरन्ति |
text:
In that they perform in the Gārhapatya the sacrifices to the wives with (the gods), the wives share the Gārhapatya, the sacrificer the Āhavanīya; therefore they perform the sacrifices for the wives with (the gods) in the Gārhapatya. They are four in number; up to four (degrees), are pairing, union, propagation; (they serve) for generation. They are performed inaudibly; the sacrifices to the wives with (the gods) are a pouring of seed; inaudibly is seed poured; they are appropriate; what in the sacrifice is appropriate is perfect; verily (they serve) for the perfection of the sacrifice. He sacrifices to Soma, Tvaṣṭṛ, the wives of the gods; and Agni, lord of the house; these deities are the controllers of unions; them here he delights; they here being delighted confer unions. To Soma first he sacrifices; thus he pours seed; to Tvaṣṭṛ second, Tvaṣṭṛ transmutes the seed that is poured; then to the wives, for these are joint sacrifices for the wives; in that he sacrifices last to Agni, lord of the house, the wives are those of him that makes the sacrifice well performed; therefore he sacrifices to him at the end. In that he mutters the Ṛc, verily thus he procures a blessing. In that he invokes the sacrificial food, in that he purifies himself, in that he utters the Śaṁyuvāka, the explanation of that has been given. In that he causes the wife to speak on the grass bundle, and the grass bundle is male and the wife female, verily thus he confers union upon women; therefore the wife puts between her thighs blades of the grass bundle. In that he strews the grass bundle, thereby the new and full moon offerings are continued by him; verily also thereby the strew for his Agnihotra is spread. In that he pays reverence to the remnant of the grass bundle, verily thus he utters a prayer for blessing; in that he pays reverence to the Āhavanīya, verily thus having delighted (them) he speaks at
the end his purpose to the gods; in that he touches the waters, and the waters are healing and medicine, verily thus at the end in the sacrifice are healing and medicine produced.

sanskrit_iast: ā caturam vai dvandvam mithunam prajananam prajātyai |
meaning: आ चतुरम् वै द्वन्द्वम् मिथुनम् प्रजननम् प्रजात्यै |

sanskrit_iast: yad yaje abhirūpam tat samṛddham yajñasya eva samṛddhyai |
meaning: यद् यजे अभिरूपम् तत् समृद्धम् यज्ञस्य एव समृद्ध्यै |

sanskrit_iast: atha somam tvaṣṭāram devānām patnīr agnim gṛhapatim iti |
meaning: अथ सोमम् त्वष्टारम् देवानाम् पत्नीर् अग्निम् गृहपतिम् इति |

sanskrit_iast: etā ha vai devatā mithunānām īśate |
meaning: एता ह वै देवता मिथुनानाम् ईशते |

sanskrit_iast: atha yad agnim gṛhapatim antato yajati |
meaning: अथ यद् अग्निम् गृहपतिम् अन्ततो यजति |

sanskrit_iast: atha ya apa upaspṛśati tasya uktam brāhmaṇam |
meaning: अथ य अप उपस्पृशति तस्य उक्तम् ब्राह्मणम् |

sanskrit_iast: atha yad ṛcam japati svastyayanam eva tat kurute |
meaning: अथ यद् ऋचम् जपति स्वस्त्ययनम् एव तत् कुरुते |

sanskrit_iast: atha yad ilām upahvayate yan mārjayate yat śamyor vākam āha tasya uktam brāhmaṇam |
meaning: अथ यद् इलाम् उपह्वयते यन् मार्जयते यत् शम्योर् वाकम् आह तस्य उक्तम् ब्राह्मणम् |

sanskrit_iast: tasmāt patnī veda tṛṇāny antara ūrū kurute |
meaning: तस्मात् पत्नी वेद तृणान्य् अन्तर ऊरू कुरुते |

sanskrit_iast: tena ha asya darśa pūrṇa māsau saṃtatau bhavataḥ |
meaning: तेन ह अस्य दर्श पूर्ण मासौ संततौ भवतः |

sanskrit_iast: atho etena eva asya agnihotram stīrṇa barhir bhavati |
meaning: अथो एतेन एव अस्य अग्निहोत्रम् स्तीर्ण बर्हिर् भवति |

sanskrit_iast: prītvā eva tad deveṣv antato artham vadate |
meaning: प्रीत्वा एव तद् देवेष्व् अन्ततो अर्थम् वदते |

sanskrit_iast: śāntir eva eṣā bheṣajam antato yajñe kriyate antato yajñe kriyate |
meaning: शान्तिर् एव एषा भेषजम् अन्ततो यज्ञे क्रियते अन्ततो यज्ञे क्रियते |

text: By means of the supplementary offering the gods smote away the Asuras; verily so also does the sacrificer by the supplementary offering smite away the foes that hate him. He offers to Indra, driver away of enemies, a cake on eleven potsherds. Indra is the smiter away of enemies; verily he smites away his enemies. Again, he adds on the new moon ceremonial. In that at the full moon sacrifice he offers to Indra, therein the sacrificer has the new and full moon sacrifices completed; if he were to incur a disaster in the second half of the month, there would not be a dragging apart of his sacrifice. In that in the new moon sacrifice he offers to Aditi, it is to balance the sacrifice. From the invitatory and offering verses it is possessed of the characteristic of driving away enemies.

sanskrit_iast: tatho eva etad yajamāno anunirvāpyayā eva dviṣato bhrātṛvyān apahate |
meaning: तथो एव एतद् यजमानो अनुनिर्वाप्यया एव द्विषतो भ्रातृव्यान् अपहते |

sanskrit_iast: sa vā indrāya vimṛdha ekādaśa kapālam puloḍāśam nirvapati |
meaning: स वा इन्द्राय विमृध एकादश कपालम् पुलोडाशम् निर्वपति |

sanskrit_iast: atho āmāvāsyam eva etat pratyāharati yat paurṇamāsyām indram yajati |
meaning: अथो आमावास्यम् एव एतत् प्रत्याहरति यत् पौर्णमास्याम् इन्द्रम् यजति |

sanskrit_iast: atra saṃsthita darśa pūrṇa māsau yajamāno yady apara pakṣe bhaṅgam nīyāt |
meaning: अत्र संस्थित दर्श पूर्ण मासौ यजमानो यद्य् अपर पक्षे भङ्गम् नीयात् |

text: Next as to the Abhyuditā sacrifice. He wanders from the path of the sacrifice at whose fast the moon is seen in the east. He offers to Agni, the giver, a cake on eight potsherds; Agni is the giver; verily he gives the sacrifice to him. (He offers) to Indra, the bestower, curds milked in the evening; Indra is the bestower; verily he bestows the sacrifice upon him. (He offers) to Viṣṇu Śipiviṣṭa a pap in milk milked in the morning; Viṣṇu is the sacrifice; verily he gives to him the sacrifice. In that he sacrifices to these deities, (it is because he thinks) 'Let me not wander from the path of the sacrifice.' The sacrificial fee is a bow with three arrows; that is a symbol of a safe journey.

sanskrit_iast: ehi ha vā eṣa yaja pathāt |
meaning: एहि ह वा एष यज पथात् |

sanskrit_iast: so agnaye dātre aṣṭā kapālam puroḍāśam nirvapati |
meaning: सो अग्नये दात्रे अष्टा कपालम् पुरोडाशम् निर्वपति |

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇave śipi viṣṭāya prātar dohite payasi carum |
meaning: विष्णवे शिपि विष्टाय प्रातर् दोहिते पयसि चरुम् |

sanskrit_iast: na id yajña pathād ayāni iti |
meaning: न इद् यज्ञ पथाद् अयानि इति |

text: Next as to the Abhyuddṛṣṭā sacrifice. He wanders from the path of the sacrifice at whose fast the moon is seen in the west. He offers to Agni, maker of paths, a cake on eight potsherds; Agni is the maker of paths; verily he sets him again on the path of the sacrifice. To Indra, slayer of Vṛtra, (he offers a cake) on eleven potsherds; Indra is the slayer of Vṛtra; verily he sets him again on the path of the sacrifice. To Vaiśvānara (he offers a cake) on twelve potsherds; he who yonder gives heat is Vaiśvānara; verily he sets him again on the path of the sacrifice. In that he sacrifices to these deities, (it is because he thinks) ‘Let me not wander from the path of the sacrifice.’ The sacrificial fee is a pair of shoes and a staff; that is the symbol of fearlessness.

sanskrit_iast: ehi ha vā eṣa yajña pathāt |
meaning: एहि ह वा एष यज्ञ पथात् |

sanskrit_iast: so agnaye pathi kṛte aṣṭā kapālam puroḍāśam nirvapati |
meaning: सो अग्नये पथि कृते अष्टा कपालम् पुरोडाशम् निर्वपति |

sanskrit_iast: sa eva enam yajña patham apipātayati |
meaning: स एव एनम् यज्ञ पथम् अपिपातयति |

sanskrit_iast: sa eva enam punar yajña patham apipātayati |
meaning: स एव एनम् पुनर् यज्ञ पथम् अपिपातयति |

sanskrit_iast: asau vai vaiśvānaro yo asau tapati |
meaning: असौ वै वैश्वानरो यो असौ तपति |

sanskrit_iast: eṣa eva enam punar yajña patham apipātayati |
meaning: एष एव एनम् पुनर् यज्ञ पथम् अपिपातयति |

sanskrit_iast: na id yajña pathād ayāni iti |
meaning: न इद् यज्ञ पथाद् अयानि इति |

text:
Next as to the Dākṣāyaṇa sacrifice. He who means to proceed with the Dākṣāyaṇa sacrifice begins on the full moon night in the Phalgunīs; the full moon night in the Phalgunīs is the beginning of the year; therefore on it the proceedings of the unconsecrated are begun. Now Dakṣa Pārvatī, having sacrificed with this sacrifice, obtained all desires; in that he sacrifices with the Dākṣāyaṇa sacrifice, verily (it serves) for the obtaining of all desires. He should not take pleasure in eating; ‘Soma, the king, the moon I eat’, thus thinking in his mind should he eat; now the moon is Soma, the king, the wise; it on the second half of the month the gods press out. In that on the second half of the month he performs the vows of the Dākṣāyaṇa sacrifice, (it is because he wishes) ‘Let me share in the Soma drinking of the gods.’ In that during the fast day he offers a cake on eleven potsherds to Agni and Soma, thereby he obtains the victim for
Agni and Soma which is offered on the fast day of the Soma (sacrifice). In that he sacrifices in the morning with the new moon offerings, and the pressing day is Indra's, thus he obtains the pressing day. In that at the new moon offering on the fast day he offers a cake on twelve potsherds to Indra and Agni and the third pressing belongs as regards its Sāman to Indra and Agni, thus he obtains the third pressing. In that there is a milk mess for Mitra and Varuṇa, and the offering (of a cow) is for Mitra and Varuṇa, thus he obtains the offering of a cow. Thus Soma is present, having penetrated the Haviryajñas; therefore though unconsecrated he performs the vows of the consecrated.

sanskrit_iast: dākṣāyaṇa yajñena iṣyan phālgunyām paurṇamāsyām prayuṅkte |
meaning: दाक्षायण यज्ञेन इष्यन् फाल्गुन्याम् पौर्णमास्याम् प्रयुङ्क्ते |

sanskrit_iast: mukham vā etat saṃvatsarasya yat phālgunī paurṇamāsī |
meaning: मुखम् वा एतत् संवत्सरस्य यत् फाल्गुनी पौर्णमासी |

sanskrit_iast: atho dakṣo ha vai pārvatir etena yajñena iṣṭvā sarvān kāmān āpa |
meaning: अथो दक्षो ह वै पार्वतिर् एतेन यज्ञेन इष्ट्वा सर्वान् कामान् आप |

sanskrit_iast: somam rājānam candramasam bhakṣayāni iti manasā dhyāyann aśnīyāt |
meaning: सोमम् राजानम् चन्द्रमसम् भक्षयानि इति मनसा ध्यायन्न् अश्नीयात् |

sanskrit_iast: tad asau vai somo rājā vicakṣaṇaś candramāḥ |
meaning: तद् असौ वै सोमो राजा विचक्षणश् चन्द्रमाः |

sanskrit_iast: tam etam apara parkṣam devā abhiṣuṇvanti |
meaning: तम् एतम् अपर पर्क्षम् देवा अभिषुण्वन्ति |

sanskrit_iast: tad yad apara pakṣam dākṣāyaṇa yajñasya vratāni caranti |
meaning: तद् यद् अपर पक्षम् दाक्षायण यज्ञस्य व्रतानि चरन्ति |

sanskrit_iast: devānām api soma pītho asāni iti |
meaning: देवानाम् अपि सोम पीथो असानि इति |

sanskrit_iast: atha yad upavasathe agnīṣomīyam ekādaśa kapālam puroḍāśam nirvapati |
meaning: अथ यद् उपवसथे अग्नीषोमीयम् एकादश कपालम् पुरोडाशम् निर्वपति |

sanskrit_iast: ya eva asau somasya upavasathe agnīṣomīyaḥ |
meaning: य एव असौ सोमस्य उपवसथे अग्नीषोमीयः |

sanskrit_iast: atha yad amāvāsyāyā upavasatha aindrāgnam dvādaśa kapālam puroḍāśam nirvapati |
meaning: अथ यद् अमावास्याया उपवसथ ऐन्द्राग्नम् द्वादश कपालम् पुरोडाशम् निर्वपति |

sanskrit_iast: sa eṣa somo havir yajñān anupraviṣṭaḥ |
meaning: स एष सोमो हविर् यज्ञान् अनुप्रविष्टः |

text: Next as to the Iḍādadha sacrifice. He who means to proceed with the Iḍādadha sacrifice begins on the same full moon night; the explanation of it has been given. It is a sacrifice for one desiring cattle or desiring proper food. With it should one desiring cattle or one desiring proper food sacrifice; verily in it thus also does he perform the vows, for it is a combination of the Dākṣāyaṇa sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: iḍādadhena iṣyann etasyām eva paurṇamāsyām prayuṅkte tasyā uktam brāhmaṇam |
meaning: इडादधेन इष्यन्न् एतस्याम् एव पौर्णमास्याम् प्रयुङ्क्ते तस्या उक्तम् ब्राह्मणम् |

sanskrit_iast: sa eṣa paśu kāmasya anna adya kāmasya yajñaḥ |
meaning: स एष पशु कामस्य अन्न अद्य कामस्य यज्ञः |

sanskrit_iast: tena paśu kāmo anna adya kāmo yajeta |
meaning: तेन पशु कामो अन्न अद्य कामो यजेत |

text: Next as to the Sārvaseni sacrifice. He who means to proceed with the Sārvaseni sacrifice begins on the same full moon night; the explanation of it has been given. It is a sacrifice for one desiring propagation; with it should one desiring propagation sacrifice. In that the Adhvaryu produces the oblation, that is the symbol of propagation.

sanskrit_iast: sārvaseni yajñena iṣyann etasyām eva paurṇamāsyām prayuṅkte tasyā uktam brāhmaṇam |
meaning: सार्वसेनि यज्ञेन इष्यन्न् एतस्याम् एव पौर्णमास्याम् प्रयुङ्क्ते तस्या उक्तम् ब्राह्मणम् |

sanskrit_iast: sa ya icched dviṣantam bhrātṛvyam stṛṇvīya iti |
meaning: स य इच्छेद् द्विषन्तम् भ्रातृव्यम् स्तृण्वीय इति |

text: Next as to the Śaunaka sacrifice. He who means to proceed with the Śaunaka sacrifice begins on the same full moon night; the explanation of this has been given. It is a sacrifice for one desiring to lay low (his enemies); with it should one desiring to lay low sacrifice; he who desires 'May I lay low the rival who hates me', should sacrifice with this; he lays him low indeed.

sanskrit_iast: śaunaka yajñena iṣyann etasyām eva paurṇamāsyām prayuṅkte tasyā uktam brāhmaṇam |
meaning: शौनक यज्ञेन इष्यन्न् एतस्याम् एव पौर्णमास्याम् प्रयुङ्क्ते तस्या उक्तम् ब्राह्मणम् |

sanskrit_iast: tad yad adhvaryur havīṃṣi prajanayati tat prajātyai rūpam |
meaning: तद् यद् अध्वर्युर् हवींषि प्रजनयति तत् प्रजात्यै रूपम् |

text: Next as to the Vasiṣṭha sacrifice. He who means to proceed with the Vasiṣṭha sacrifice begins on the new moon in the Phalgunis (thinking) ‘The full moon night is the holy power; the new moon night is the lordly power; this sacrifice is, as it were, the lordly power. By means of the lordly power let me overcome my foes.’ Vasiṣṭha desired, when his sons were slain, ‘May I be propagated with offspring, with cattle, may I overcome the Saudāsas.’ He saw this sacrificial rite, the Vasiṣṭha sacrifice; he grasped it and sacrificed with it; having sacrificed with it, he was propagated with offspring, with cattle; he overcame the Saudāsas. Verily thus also the sacrificer, in that he sacrifices with the Vasiṣṭha sacrifice, is propagated with offspring, with cattle; he overcomes the rivals who hate him.

sanskrit_iast: vasiṣṭha yajñena iṣyan phālgunyām amāvāsyāyām prayuṅkte |
meaning: वसिष्ठ यज्ञेन इष्यन् फाल्गुन्याम् अमावास्यायाम् प्रयुङ्क्ते |

sanskrit_iast: vasiṣṭho akāmayata hata putraḥ prajāyena prajayā paśubhir abhi saudāsān bhaveyam iti |
meaning: वसिष्ठो अकामयत हत पुत्रः प्रजायेन प्रजया पशुभिर् अभि सौदासान् भवेयम् इति |

sanskrit_iast: sa etam yajña kratum apaśyad vasiṣṭha yajñam |
meaning: स एतम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यद् वसिष्ठ यज्ञम् |

sanskrit_iast: tena iṣṭvā prājāyata prajayā paśubhir abhi saudāsān abhavat |
meaning: तेन इष्ट्वा प्राजायत प्रजया पशुभिर् अभि सौदासान् अभवत् |

sanskrit_iast: tatho eva etad yajamāno yad vasiṣṭha yajñena yajane |
meaning: तथो एव एतद् यजमानो यद् वसिष्ठ यज्ञेन यजने |

sanskrit_iast: prajāyate prajayā paśubhir abhi dviṣato bhrātṛvyān bhavati |
meaning: प्रजायते प्रजया पशुभिर् अभि द्विषतो भ्रातृव्यान् भवति |

text:
Next as to the Sākaṁprasthāyya sacrifice. He who means to proceed with the Sākaṁprasthāyya begins on the same new moon night; the explanation of it has been given. It is a sacrifice for one desiring pre-eminence, desiring heroism; with it should one desiring pre-eminence, desiring heroism, sacrifice. In that together they move forward, together they sacrifice, together they eat, therefore is it called Sākaṁprasthāyya (moving forward together).
iv 10. Next as to the Munyayana. He who means to proceed with the Munyayana begins on the same full moon night; the explanation of it has been given. It is a sacrifice for one desiring all; with it should one desiring all sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: sākam prasthāyyena iṣyann etasyām eva amāvāsyāyām prayuṅkte tasyā uktam brāhmaṇam |
meaning: साकम् प्रस्थाय्येन इष्यन्न् एतस्याम् एव अमावास्यायाम् प्रयुङ्क्ते तस्या उक्तम् ब्राह्मणम् |

sanskrit_iast: sa eṣa śraiṣṭhya kāmasya pauruṣa kāmasya yajñaḥ |
meaning: स एष श्रैष्ठ्य कामस्य पौरुष कामस्य यज्ञः |

sanskrit_iast: tena śraiṣṭhya kāmaḥ pauruṣa kāmo yajate |
meaning: तेन श्रैष्ठ्य कामः पौरुष कामो यजते |

sanskrit_iast: munyayanena iṣyann etasyām eva paurṇamāsyām prayuṅkte tasyā uktam brāhmaṇam |
meaning: मुन्ययनेन इष्यन्न् एतस्याम् एव पौर्णमास्याम् प्रयुङ्क्ते तस्या उक्तम् ब्राह्मणम् |

text:
Next as to the Turāyaṇa. He who means to proceed with the Turāyaṇa begins on the same full moon night; the explanation of this has been given. It is a sacrifice for one desiring heaven; with it should one
desiring heaven sacrifice. In that he puts on a black antelope’s skin, and the black antelope’s skin is the holy power, verily thus he unites the sacrifice with holy power. There are three oblations; these worlds are three; verily thus he obtains these worlds.

sanskrit_iast: turāyaṇena iṣyann etasyām eva paurṇamāsyām prayuṅkte tasyā uktam brāhmaṇam |
meaning: तुरायणेन इष्यन्न् एतस्याम् एव पौर्णमास्याम् प्रयुङ्क्ते तस्या उक्तम् ब्राह्मणम् |

text: Next as to the Āgrayaṇa. He who desires proper food should sacrifice with the Āgrayaṇa. In the rains when the millet harvest has come, he gives orders to pluck millet. The new moon night which coincides with that time, on it should he sacrifice and then offer this sacrifice. If he is a full moon sacrificer, he should sacrifice with this and then offer the full moon sacrifice. If again he desires a Nakṣatra, he should in the first half of the month look out for a Nakṣatra and offer under the Nakṣatra which he desires. There are seventeen kindling verses in this sacrifice, the butter portions contain the word ‘being’; the invitatory and offering verses (of the Sviṣṭakṛt offering) are Virāj verses; the explanation of that has been given. There is a pap for Soma; Soma is the king of the plants; thus he delights him with his own subjects. In that he gives the honey drink, it is because this is the sap of the forest things.

sanskrit_iast: āgrayaṇena anna adya kāmo yajeta varṣās āgate śyāmāka sasye |
meaning: आग्रयणेन अन्न अद्य कामो यजेत वर्षास् आगते श्यामाक सस्ये |

sanskrit_iast: sā yā tasmin kāle amāvāsyā upasampadyeta |
meaning: सा या तस्मिन् काले अमावास्या उपसम्पद्येत |

sanskrit_iast: tayā iṣṭvā atha etayā iṣṭyā yajeta |
meaning: तया इष्ट्वा अथ एतया इष्ट्या यजेत |

sanskrit_iast: pūrva pakṣe nakṣatram udīkṣya yasmin kalyāṇe nakṣatre kāmayeta tasmin yajeta |
meaning: पूर्व पक्षे नक्षत्रम् उदीक्ष्य यस्मिन् कल्याणे नक्षत्रे कामयेत तस्मिन् यजेत |

sanskrit_iast: tasyai saptadaśa sāmidhenyaḥ sadvāntāv ājya bhāgau virājau samyājye tasya uktam brāhmaṇam |
meaning: तस्यै सप्तदश सामिधेन्यः सद्वान्ताव् आज्य भागौ विराजौ सम्याज्ये तस्य उक्तम् ब्राह्मणम् |

sanskrit_iast: atha vasanta āgate pakveṣu veṇu yaveṣu |
meaning: अथ वसन्त आगते पक्वेषु वेणु यवेषु |
text: When spring has come and the bamboo seeds are ripe, he gives orders to pluck bamboo seeds. Of this (sacrifice) there is the same time, the same model, the same deity, the same fee, the same explanation. Some perform (the offering) for Agni, or Varuṇa, or Prajāpati, but with the same model and the same explanation.

sanskrit_iast: tasyā etad eva parva etat tantram eṣā devatā eṣā dakṣiṇā etad brāhmaṇam |
meaning: तस्या एतद् एव पर्व एतत् तन्त्रम् एषा देवता एषा दक्षिणा एतद् ब्राह्मणम् |

sanskrit_iast: tām ha eka āgneyīm vā vāruṇīm vā prājāpatyām vā kurvanty etat tantrām eva etad brāhmaṇām |
meaning: ताम् ह एक आग्नेयीम् वा वारुणीम् वा प्राजापत्याम् वा कुर्वन्त्य् एतत् तन्त्राम् एव एतद् ब्राह्मणाम् |

sanskrit_iast: atha vrīhi sasye vā yava sasye vā āgate |
meaning: अथ व्रीहि सस्ये वा यव सस्ये वा आगते |
text:
When the rice harvest or the barley harvest has come, he gives orders to pluck (grains) for the Āgrayaṇa: of this (sacrifice) there is the same time, the same model. In that there is (a cake) on twelve potsherds for
Indra and Agni, and Indra and Agni are the beginning of the gods, verily thus at the beginning he delights the gods. In that there is a pap for the All-gods, and the All-gods are all the gods, verily (it serves) to delight all the gods. In that there is (a cake) on one potsherd for sky and earth, (it is because) sky and earth are the preparers of the harvest, and earth is a support, and by the flooding yonder (sky) co-operates. In that he sacrifices to these deities, (it is because he thinks) 'By these deities shall I eat food made calm.' In that he gives an ox of the first birth, it is because this is a first ceremony. If he is wearied of this (sacrifice), he should offer the oblation of the full or the new moon, with the new (plants) to obtain both. Or again he may employ the oblations at the full moon or the new moon (sacrifice) to secure the presence of the deities. Or again he may offer in the morning and in the evening the Agnihotra with barley gruel of the new (plants), to obtain both. Or again having cooked milk in a pot on the Gārhapatya he should make an offering of the new (plants) in the Āhavanīya to the gods of the Āgrayaṇa, with Sviṣṭakṛt for a fourth (saying) 'To N.N. hail. To N.N. hail!' to secure the presence of the deities. Or again having made the Agnihotra cow to eat the new (plants), he should offer in the morning and in the evening the Agnihotra with its milk, to obtain both. These are so many possibilities; he may offer with whichever he may desire, but the established rule is that of three oblations. Three are these worlds; verily thus he obtains these worlds.

sanskrit_iast: tasyā etad eva parva etat tantram |
meaning: तस्या एतद् एव पर्व एतत् तन्त्रम् |

sanskrit_iast: ete vai sarve devā yad viśve devāḥ |
meaning: एते वै सर्वे देवा यद् विश्वे देवाः |

sanskrit_iast: atha yad dyāvā pṛthivīya eka kapālaḥ |
meaning: अथ यद् द्यावा पृथिवीय एक कपालः |

sanskrit_iast: etābhir devatābhiḥ śāntam annam atsyāmi iti |
meaning: एताभिर् देवताभिः शान्तम् अन्नम् अत्स्यामि इति |

sanskrit_iast: paurṇamāsam vā amāvāsyam vā haviṣ kurvīta navānām ubhayasya āptyai |
meaning: पौर्णमासम् वा अमावास्यम् वा हविष् कुर्वीत नवानाम् उभयस्य आप्त्यै |

sanskrit_iast: api vā paurṇamāse vā amāvāsye vā havīṃṣy anuvartayed devatānām aparihāṇāya |
meaning: अपि वा पौर्णमासे वा अमावास्ये वा हवींष्य् अनुवर्तयेद् देवतानाम् अपरिहाणाय |

sanskrit_iast: api vā yavāg vā eva sāyam prātar agnihotram juhuyān navānām ubhayasya āptyai |
meaning: अपि वा यवाग् वा एव सायम् प्रातर् अग्निहोत्रम् जुहुयान् नवानाम् उभयस्य आप्त्यै |

sanskrit_iast: api vā sthālī pākam eva gārhapatye śrapayitvā navānām etābhya āgrayaṇa devatābhya āhavanīye juhuyāt sviṣṭakṛc caturthībhyo amuṣyai svāhā amuṣyai svāhā iti devatānām aparihāṇāya |
meaning: अपि वा स्थाली पाकम् एव गार्हपत्ये श्रपयित्वा नवानाम् एताभ्य आग्रयण देवताभ्य आहवनीये जुहुयात् स्विष्टकृच् चतुर्थीभ्यो अमुष्यै स्वाहा अमुष्यै स्वाहा इति देवतानाम् अपरिहाणाय |

sanskrit_iast: api vā agnihotrīm eva navān ādayitvā tasyai dugdhena sāyam prātar agnihotram juhuyād ubhayasya āptyai |
meaning: अपि वा अग्निहोत्रीम् एव नवान् आदयित्वा तस्यै दुग्धेन सायम् प्रातर् अग्निहोत्रम् जुहुयाद् उभयस्य आप्त्यै |

sanskrit_iast: imān eva tal lokān āpnoti imān eva tal lokān āpnoti |
meaning: इमान् एव तल् लोकान् आप्नोति इमान् एव तल् लोकान् आप्नोति |

text:
Next as to the four-monthly sacrifices. He who prepares the four-monthly sacrifices begins on the full moon night in the Phalgunīs.
The full moon night is the Phalgunīs in the beginning of the year; the latter two Phalgus are the beginning, the two former the end. Just as the two ends of what is round may unite, so these two ends of the year are connected. In that he sacrifices with the Vaiśvadeva sacrifice on the full moon night in the Phalgunīs, verily thus at the beginning he delights the year. Again the four-monthly sacrifices are sacrifices of healing; therefore are they performed in the joinings of the seasons, for in the joinings of the seasons pain is born. There are eight oblations, the oblations of four full moon days amount to eight; the Vaiśvadeva is a compound of four full moon days. In that Agni is kindled, it is because the Vaiśvadeva is propagation; therefore he generates this divine embryo. As to there being seventeen kindling verses, the butter portions containing the word 'being', the invitatory and offering verses being Virāj verses, the explanation of that has been given. In that there are nine fore-offerings and nine after-offerings, eight oblations and the offering for the steeds as the ninth, thus he obtains the brilliance of the Nakṣatras.

sanskrit_iast: mukham vā etat saṃvatsarasya yat phālgunī paurṇamāsī |
meaning: मुखम् वा एतत् संवत्सरस्य यत् फाल्गुनी पौर्णमासी |

sanskrit_iast: tad yathā pravṛttasya antau sametau syātām |
meaning: तद् यथा प्रवृत्तस्य अन्तौ समेतौ स्याताम् |

sanskrit_iast: evam eva etau saṃvatsarasya antau sametau |
meaning: एवम् एव एतौ संवत्सरस्य अन्तौ समेतौ |

sanskrit_iast: tad yat phālgunyām paurṇamāsyām vaiśvadevena yajeta |
meaning: तद् यत् फाल्गुन्याम् पौर्णमास्याम् वैश्वदेवेन यजेत |

sanskrit_iast: atho bhaiṣajya yajñā vā ete yac cāturmāsyāni |
meaning: अथो भैषज्य यज्ञा वा एते यच् चातुर्मास्यानि |

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭau vai catasṛṇām paurṇamāsīnām havīṃṣi bhavanti |
meaning: अष्टौ वै चतसृणाम् पौर्णमासीनाम् हवींषि भवन्ति |

sanskrit_iast: atha yat saptadaśa sāmidhenyaḥ sadvantāv ājya bhāgau virājau samyājye tasya uktam brāhmaṇam |
meaning: अथ यत् सप्तदश सामिधेन्यः सद्वन्ताव् आज्य भागौ विराजौ सम्याज्ये तस्य उक्तम् ब्राह्मणम् |

sanskrit_iast: atha yan nava prayājā nava anuyājā aṣṭau havīṃṣi vājinam navamam |
meaning: अथ यन् नव प्रयाजा नव अनुयाजा अष्टौ हवींषि वाजिनम् नवमम् |

sanskrit_iast: atha yad agnīṣomau prathamau devatānām yajati |
meaning: अथ यद् अग्नीषोमौ प्रथमौ देवतानाम् यजति |
text:
In that he sacrifices to Agni and Soma first of the deities, it is because these are the deities of the new and full moon sacrifices; therefore to them first he sacrifices. In that he sacrifices to Savitṛ, and Savitṛ is lord of instigations, (it serves) for the creation of instigation by Savitṛ. In that he sacrifices to Sarasvatī, and Sarasvatī is speech, verily thus he delights speech. In that he sacrifices to Pūṣan and Pūṣan is he who yonder gives heat, verily thus he delights him. In that he sacrifices to the Maruts as impetuous, and the Maruts as impetuous are terrible, verily thus he makes healing. In that there is a milk mess for the All-gods, and the All-gods are all these gods, verily (it serves) to delight all the gods. In that there is (a cake) on one potsherd for the sky and earth, and sky and earth are supports, verily (it serves) for support. In that he gives an ox of the first birth, it is because that is a first ceremony. In that before or after the Śaṁyuvāka, he sacrifices to the steeds uninvited, and the steeds are the horses of the gods, verily thus he delights these steeds.
Therefore the gods with their horses become delighted. Now the steeds are also the seasons; verily thus he delights the seasons. In that he sacrifices afterwards with the full moon offering, thus by him in the first half of the month is the Vaiśvadeva offered.

sanskrit_iast: asau vai pūṣā yo asau tapati |
meaning: असौ वै पूषा यो असौ तपति |

sanskrit_iast: atha yan marutaḥ sva tavaso yajati |
meaning: अथ यन् मरुतः स्व तवसो यजति |

sanskrit_iast: ete vai sarve devā yad viśve devāḥ |
meaning: एते वै सर्वे देवा यद् विश्वे देवाः |

sanskrit_iast: atha yad dyāvā pṛthivīya eka kapālaḥ |
meaning: अथ यद् द्यावा पृथिवीय एक कपालः |

sanskrit_iast: pratiṣṭhe vai dyāvā pṛthivī pratiṣṭhityā eva |
meaning: प्रतिष्ठे वै द्यावा पृथिवी प्रतिष्ठित्या एव |

sanskrit_iast: atha yat purastād vā upariṣṭād vā śamyor vākasyān āvāhitān vājino yajati |
meaning: अथ यत् पुरस्ताद् वा उपरिष्टाद् वा शम्योर् वाकस्यान् आवाहितान् वाजिनो यजति |

sanskrit_iast: atra devāḥ sa aśvāḥ prītā bhavanti |
meaning: अत्र देवाः स अश्वाः प्रीता भवन्ति |

sanskrit_iast: tathā ha asya pūrva pakṣe vaiśvadevena iṣṭam bhavati |
meaning: तथा ह अस्य पूर्व पक्षे वैश्वदेवेन इष्टम् भवति |

text: By means of the Vaiśvadeva sacrifice Prajāpati created offspring; they, being created, not born, ate the barley of Varuṇa; Varuṇa grasped them with Varuṇa's nooses. The offspring having gone ran up to their father Prajāpati, 'Do thou devise that sacrificial rite by which we may sacrifice and be set free from the nooses of Varuṇa, from all ill.' Then Prajāpati saw this sacrificial rite, the Varuṇapraghāsas; he grasped it, and sacrificed with it; having sacrificed with it he delighted Varuṇa; Varuṇa being delighted, freed offspring from the nooses of Varuṇa and from all evil. From the nooses of Varuṇa and from all evil are freed the offspring of him who knowing thus sacrifices with the Praghasas. In that they bring forward the fire, verily thus do they bring forward yonder fire which they kindle at the Vaiśvadeva. In that the fire is kindled, the explanation of that has been given. In that there are seventeen kindling verses, the butter portions contain the word 'being' and the invitatory and offering verses are Virāj verses, the explanation of that has been given. In that there are nine fore-offerings and nine after-offerings, and nine oblations, thus he obtains the brilliance of the Nakṣatras; the five accompanying oblations ending with that to Pūṣan are the same; the explanation of them has been given.

sanskrit_iast: tāḥ sṛṣṭā aprasūtā varuṇasya yavān jakṣuḥ |
meaning: ताः सृष्टा अप्रसूता वरुणस्य यवान् जक्षुः |

sanskrit_iast: tāḥ prajāḥ prajāpatim pitaram etya upādhāvan |
meaning: ताः प्रजाः प्रजापतिम् पितरम् एत्य उपाधावन् |

sanskrit_iast: upa tam yajña kratum jānīhi yena iṣṭvā varuṇa pāśebhyaḥ sarvasmāc ca pāpmanaḥ sampramucyemahi iti |
meaning: उप तम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् जानीहि येन इष्ट्वा वरुण पाशेभ्यः सर्वस्माच् च पाप्मनः सम्प्रमुच्येमहि इति |

sanskrit_iast: tata etam prajāpatir yajña kratum apaśyad varuṇa praghāsān |
meaning: तत एतम् प्रजापतिर् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यद् वरुण प्रघासान् |

sanskrit_iast: sa prīto varuṇo varuṇa pāśebhyaḥ sarvasmāc ca pāpmanaḥ prajāḥ prāmuñcat |
meaning: स प्रीतो वरुणो वरुण पाशेभ्यः सर्वस्माच् च पाप्मनः प्रजाः प्रामुञ्चत् |

sanskrit_iast: pra ha vā asya prajā varuṇa pāśebhyaḥ sarvasmāc ca pāpmanaḥ sampramucyate ya evam veda |
meaning: प्र ह वा अस्य प्रजा वरुण पाशेभ्यः सर्वस्माच् च पाप्मनः सम्प्रमुच्यते य एवम् वेद |

sanskrit_iast: atha yan mathyate tasya uktam brāhmaṇam |
meaning: अथ यन् मथ्यते तस्य उक्तम् ब्राह्मणम् |

sanskrit_iast: atha yat saptadaśa sāmidhenyaḥ sadvantāv ājya bhāgau virājau samyājye tasya uktam brāhmaṇam |
meaning: अथ यत् सप्तदश सामिधेन्यः सद्वन्ताव् आज्य भागौ विराजौ सम्याज्ये तस्य उक्तम् ब्राह्मणम् |

sanskrit_iast: atha yan nava prayājā nava anuyājā nava etāni havīṃṣi |
meaning: अथ यन् नव प्रयाजा नव अनुयाजा नव एतानि हवींषि |

sanskrit_iast: samānāni pañca saṃcarāṇi havīṃṣi bhavanti pauṣṇa antāni vaiśvadevikāni |
meaning: समानानि पञ्च संचराणि हवींषि भवन्ति पौष्ण अन्तानि वैश्वदेविकानि |

text:
In that there is (a cake) on twelve potsherds for Indra and Agni, and Indra and Agni are supports, verily (it serves) for support. Indra is in the middle; therefore to him in the middle he sacrifices. In that there is a milk mess for Varuṇa, (it is because) Varuṇa is Indra, and he has milk as his portion; therefore there is a milk mess for Varuṇa. In that there is a milk mess for the Maruts, (it is because) the Maruts are situated in the waters; therefore with milk he sacrifices to them, for milk is the waters. Moreover the Maruts are Indra's, milk is Indra's; therefore is there a milk mess for the Maruts. In that there is (a cake) on one potsherd for Ka,
and Ka is Prajāpati, verily thus he delights him; moreover the word Ka is a name of happiness; verily thus he confers happiness upon himself. In that he gives two pairing cattle, that is the symbol of propagation. In that he sacrifices to the steeds, the explanation of that has been given. In that he sacrifices to Varuṇa in the waters, verily thus he delights him in his own home. In that afterwards he sacrifices with the full moon sacrifice, thus in the first half of the month does he sacrifice with the Varuṇapraghāsas.

sanskrit_iast: atho sukhasya eva etan nāmadheyam kam iti |
meaning: अथो सुखस्य एव एतन् नामधेयम् कम् इति |

sanskrit_iast: sva eva enam tad āyatane prīṇāti |
meaning: स्व एव एनम् तद् आयतने प्रीणाति |

sanskrit_iast: tathā ha asya pūrva pakṣe varuṇa praghāsair iṣṭam bhavati |
meaning: तथा ह अस्य पूर्व पक्षे वरुण प्रघासैर् इष्टम् भवति |

sanskrit_iast: aindro vā eṣa yajña kratur yat sākamedhāḥ |
meaning: ऐन्द्रो वा एष यज्ञ क्रतुर् यत् साकमेधाः |
text:
The Sākamedhas are a sacrificial rite for Indra. Just as a great king placing in front the advance guard of his army, pursues his way in safety, verily so does he sacrifice in front to the gods. Just as there is that Mahāvrata in the Soma sacrifice, even so is this a Mahāvrata in the Iṣṭi sacrifice. In that he offers to Agni of the front first of the deities, and Agni is the beginning of the gods, thus at the beginning he delights the gods. In that at midday he sacrifices to the Maruts, the heaters, (it is because) it is hot at midday; therefore at the midday he sacrifices to the Maruts, the heaters. Moreover, the Maruts are Indra's, the midday is Indra's; therefore at the midday he sacrifices to the Maruts, heaters. In that in the evening they proceed with the householder's sacrifice and the householder's sacrifice is a rite for prosperity, and prosperity is in the evening, therefore he offers the butter portions with the word 'prosperity'; verily thus he makes the sacrificer to prosper. In that in the morning they proceed with a full ladle, verily thus he unites the ceremony in the morning with the ceremony on the previous day. In that he sacrifices to the Maruts, the playful, and the Maruts, the playful, are Indra's, therefore he sacrifices to them in conjunction with Indra. In that they bring forward the fire, that it is kindled, the explanation of that has been given. In that there are seventeen kindling verses, the butter portions contain the word 'being', and the invitatory and offering verses (of the Sviṣṭakṛt) are Virāj verses, the explanation of that has been given. In that there are nine fore-offerings, nine after-offerings, eight oblations and the Sviṣṭakṛt as ninth, thus he obtains the brilliance of the Nakṣatras. The six accompanying oblations ending with that to Indra and Agni are the same, the explanation of them
has been given. In that he sacrifices at the end to Mahendra, (it is because) the leader occupies the end; therefore at the end he sacrifices to him. In that there is (a cake) on one potsherd for Viśvakarman, and he yonder that gives heat is Viśvakarman, verily thus he delights him. In that he gives a bull, (it is) because the sacrificial rite is Indra's.

sanskrit_iast: tad yathā mahā rājaḥ purastāt senānīkāni pratyūhya abhayam panthānam anviyāt |
meaning: तद् यथा महा राजः पुरस्तात् सेनानीकानि प्रत्यूह्य अभयम् पन्थानम् अन्वियात् |

sanskrit_iast: evam eva etat purastād devatā yajati |
meaning: एवम् एव एतत् पुरस्ताद् देवता यजति |

sanskrit_iast: tad yathā adaḥ somasya mahā vratam |
meaning: तद् यथा अदः सोमस्य महा व्रतम् |

sanskrit_iast: evam eva etad iṣṭi mahā vratam |
meaning: एवम् एव एतद् इष्टि महा व्रतम् |

sanskrit_iast: atha yad agnim anīkavantam prathamam devatānām yajati |
meaning: अथ यद् अग्निम् अनीकवन्तम् प्रथमम् देवतानाम् यजति |

sanskrit_iast: atha yan madhyaṃdine marutaḥ sāṃtapanāt yajati |
meaning: अथ यन् मध्यंदिने मरुतः सांतपनात् यजति |

sanskrit_iast: atha yat sāyam gṛha medhīyena caranti |
meaning: अथ यत् सायम् गृह मेधीयेन चरन्ति |

sanskrit_iast: puṣṭi karma vā etad yad gṛha medhīyaḥ |
meaning: पुष्टि कर्म वा एतद् यद् गृह मेधीयः |

sanskrit_iast: atha yat prātaḥ pūrṇa darveṇa caranti |
meaning: अथ यत् प्रातः पूर्ण दर्वेण चरन्ति |

sanskrit_iast: pūrve dyuḥ karmaṇā eva etat prātaḥ karma upasaṃtanoti |
meaning: पूर्वे द्युः कर्मणा एव एतत् प्रातः कर्म उपसंतनोति |

sanskrit_iast: atha yan mahā indram antato yajati |
meaning: अथ यन् महा इन्द्रम् अन्ततो यजति |

sanskrit_iast: atha yad agnim praṇayanti yan mathyate tasya uktam brāhmaṇam |
meaning: अथ यद् अग्निम् प्रणयन्ति यन् मथ्यते तस्य उक्तम् ब्राह्मणम् |

sanskrit_iast: atha yat saptadaśa sāmidhenyaḥ sadvantāv ājya bhāgau virājau samyājye tasya uktam brāhmaṇam |
meaning: अथ यत् सप्तदश सामिधेन्यः सद्वन्ताव् आज्य भागौ विराजौ सम्याज्ये तस्य उक्तम् ब्राह्मणम् |

sanskrit_iast: atha yan nava prayājā nava anuyājā aṣṭau havīṃṣi sviṣṭakṛn navamaḥ |
meaning: अथ यन् नव प्रयाजा नव अनुयाजा अष्टौ हवींषि स्विष्टकृन् नवमः |

sanskrit_iast: samānāni ṣaṭ saṃcarāṇi havīṃṣi bhavanty aindrāgna antāni vāruṇa praghāsikāni |
meaning: समानानि षट् संचराणि हवींषि भवन्त्य् ऐन्द्राग्न अन्तानि वारुण प्रघासिकानि |

sanskrit_iast: atha yan mahā indram yajati tasya uktam brāhmaṇam |
meaning: अथ यन् महा इन्द्रम् यजति तस्य उक्तम् ब्राह्मणम् |

sanskrit_iast: atha yad vaiśva karmaṇa eka kapālaḥ |
meaning: अथ यद् वैश्व कर्मण एक कपालः |

sanskrit_iast: asau vai viṣva karmā yo asau tapati |
meaning: असौ वै विष्व कर्मा यो असौ तपति |

sanskrit_iast: atha yad apara ahṇe pitṛ yajñena caranti |
meaning: अथ यद् अपर अह्णे पितृ यज्ञेन चरन्ति |
text: In that in the afternoon they proceed with the sacrifice to the fathers, (it is because) the fathers have the waning as their portion; therefore in the afternoon they proceed with the sacrifice to the fathers. They say 'Seeing that the fathers have the second half as their portion, then why do they sacrifice to them on the first half (of the month)?' The fathers are connected with the gods; therefore they sacrifice to them on the first half of the month. In that he recites one kindling verse only, it is because the fathers are one (offering) as it were, therefore he recites one kindling verse only. It is an Anuṣṭubh verse; the Anuṣṭubh is speech; the fathers are turned away; verily thus with the Anuṣṭubh as speech he causes them to come. In that he does not recite the Ṛṣi descent of the sacrificer, (it is because he thinks) 'Let me not place the sacrificer in the fire'. He recites this Nigada; the explanation of it has been given. In that he invites Soma with the fathers, or the fathers with Soma, the fathers sitting on this strew, and the fathers made ready by Agni, (it is because) the fathers are connected with the gods; therefore he unites them. In that he invites Agni, bearer of the oblations, (it is because) the fathers are Sviṣṭakṛt's; therefore he invites him. Some do not invite his greatness, saying 'This is the greatness of the sacrificer'; but the rule is 'He should invite', for it is the greatness of Agni.

sanskrit_iast: tasmād apara ahṇe pitṛ yajñena caranti |
meaning: तस्माद् अपर अह्णे पितृ यज्ञेन चरन्ति |

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur yad apara pakṣa bhājaḥ pitaro atha kasmād etān pūrva pakṣe yajanti iti |
meaning: तद् आहुर् यद् अपर पक्ष भाजः पितरो अथ कस्माद् एतान् पूर्व पक्षे यजन्ति इति |

sanskrit_iast: tān eva etad vācā anuṣṭubhā āgamayati |
meaning: तान् एव एतद् वाचा अनुष्टुभा आगमयति |

sanskrit_iast: atha yad yajamānasya ārṣeyam na āha |
meaning: अथ यद् यजमानस्य आर्षेयम् न आह |

sanskrit_iast: atha etam nigadam anvāha tasya uktam brāhmaṇam |
meaning: अथ एतम् निगदम् अन्वाह तस्य उक्तम् ब्राह्मणम् |

sanskrit_iast: atha yat somam pitṛmantam pitṝn vā somavataḥ pitṝn barhiṣadaḥ pitṝn agniṣv āttān ity āvāhayati |
meaning: अथ यत् सोमम् पितृमन्तम् पितॄन् वा सोमवतः पितॄन् बर्हिषदः पितॄन् अग्निष्व् आत्तान् इत्य् आवाहयति |

sanskrit_iast: atha yad agnim kavya vāhanam āvāhayati |
meaning: अथ यद् अग्निम् कव्य वाहनम् आवाहयति |

sanskrit_iast: na ha eke svam mahimānam āvāhayanti yajamānasya eṣa mahimā iti vadantaḥ |
meaning: न ह एके स्वम् महिमानम् आवाहयन्ति यजमानस्य एष महिमा इति वदन्तः |

sanskrit_iast: atha yat prayāja anuyājebhyo barhiṣmantā utsṛjati |
meaning: अथ यत् प्रयाज अनुयाजेभ्यो बर्हिष्मन्ता उत्सृजति |
text:
In that from the fore-offerings and the after-offerings he leaves out the two for the strew, (it is because he thinks) 'The strew is offspring; let me not cast offspring in the fire.' They are six; the seasons are six; the fathers are the seasons; verily thus he delights the fathers. In that he offers the butter portions with the word 'living', verily thus he causes the sacrificer to live. In that there are three for each oblation, (it is because) there are three oblations, and he cuts off from them together; therefore
there are three for each oblation. Moreover thus he discriminates the rite for the fathers from the rite for the gods. Now the fathers are at a great distance; verily he summons them with the first, brings them with the second, and offers with the third. In that he sacrifices at the end to Agni, bearer of the oblation, (it is because) the fathers are Sviṣṭakṛt's; therefore he sacrifices to him at the end. In that after invoking the sacrificial food and smelling it they do not eat it, (it is because they think) ‘The sacrificial food is cattle; let us not cast the sacrificer's cattle in the fire’. In that the Adhvaryu gives to the fathers, verily thus he delights the fathers. In that they cleanse themselves (in the place) where the filters are, and the waters are healing and medicine, verily thus at the end in the sacrifice are healing and medicine produced. In that they mutter the Ṛc, verily thus they produce a benediction. In that having gone north they reverence the Gārhapatya and the Āhavanīya, verily thus having given delight, they declare at the end their purpose to the gods. Moreover the sacrifice to the fathers is terminated in the south; verily thus they make it terminated in the north. In that having gone eastwards they reverence the sun, and the sun is the world of the gods, and the fathers are the world of the fathers, verily thus they ascend from the world of the fathers to the world of the gods. In that in the Sūktavāka he does not mention the name of the sacrificer, (it is because he thinks) ‘Let me not cast the sacrificer in the fire.’ In that they do not perform the offering to the wives with (the gods), (it is because they think) ‘Let us not cast the wives in the fire.’ In that having gone north they perform the offerings to Tryambaka, verily thus they delight Rudra in his own quarter. Moreover, the sacrifice to the fathers is terminated in the south; verily thus they make it terminated in the north. In that at the end having sacrificed he sacrifices with an Iṣṭi, (it is because) the Sākamedhas terminate in that; therefore at the end having sacrificed he sacrifices with an Iṣṭi. In that afterwards he sacrifices with the full moon offering, thus in the first half of the month he sacrifices with the Sākamedhas.

sanskrit_iast: atha yaj jīvanavantāv ājya bhāgau bhavataḥ |
meaning: अथ यज् जीवनवन्ताव् आज्य भागौ भवतः |

sanskrit_iast: atha yat tisras tisra eka ekasya haviṣo bhavanti |
meaning: अथ यत् तिस्रस् तिस्र एक एकस्य हविषो भवन्ति |

sanskrit_iast: tasmāt tisras tisra eka ekasya haviṣo bhavanti |
meaning: तस्मात् तिस्रस् तिस्र एक एकस्य हविषो भवन्ति |

sanskrit_iast: atho deva karmaṇā eva etat pitṛ karma vyāvartayati |
meaning: अथो देव कर्मणा एव एतत् पितृ कर्म व्यावर्तयति |

sanskrit_iast: atho parām u vai parāvatam pitaro gatāḥ |
meaning: अथो पराम् उ वै परावतम् पितरो गताः |

sanskrit_iast: atha yad agnim kavya vāhanam antato yajati |
meaning: अथ यद् अग्निम् कव्य वाहनम् अन्ततो यजति |

sanskrit_iast: atha yad apa upaspṛśati tasya uktam brāhmaṇam |
meaning: अथ यद् अप उपस्पृशति तस्य उक्तम् ब्राह्मणम् |

sanskrit_iast: atha yad iḍām upahūya avaghrāya na prāśnanti |
meaning: अथ यद् इडाम् उपहूय अवघ्राय न प्राश्नन्ति |

sanskrit_iast: na id yajamānasya paśun pravṛṇajāni iti |
meaning: न इद् यजमानस्य पशुन् प्रवृणजानि इति |

sanskrit_iast: atha yat pavitravati mārjayante tasya uktam brāhmaṇam |
meaning: अथ यत् पवित्रवति मार्जयन्ते तस्य उक्तम् ब्राह्मणम् |

sanskrit_iast: atha yad ṛcam japanti svastyayanam eva tat kurvate |
meaning: अथ यद् ऋचम् जपन्ति स्वस्त्ययनम् एव तत् कुर्वते |

sanskrit_iast: atha yad udañcaḥ paretya gārhapatyā āhavanīyā upatiṣṭhante |
meaning: अथ यद् उदञ्चः परेत्य गार्हपत्या आहवनीया उपतिष्ठन्ते |

sanskrit_iast: prītvā eva tad deveṣv antatato artham vadante |
meaning: प्रीत्वा एव तद् देवेष्व् अन्तततो अर्थम् वदन्ते |

sanskrit_iast: atho dakṣiṇā saṃstho vai pitṛ yajñaḥ |
meaning: अथो दक्षिणा संस्थो वै पितृ यज्ञः |

sanskrit_iast: tam eva etad udak saṃstham kurvanti |
meaning: तम् एव एतद् उदक् संस्थम् कुर्वन्ति |

sanskrit_iast: atha yat prāñca upaniṣkramya ādityam upatiṣṭhante |
meaning: अथ यत् प्राञ्च उपनिष्क्रम्य आदित्यम् उपतिष्ठन्ते |

sanskrit_iast: deva lokam eva tat pitṛ lokād abhyutkrāmanti |
meaning: देव लोकम् एव तत् पितृ लोकाद् अभ्युत्क्रामन्ति |

sanskrit_iast: atha yat sūkta vāke yajamānasya nāma na gṛhṇāti |
meaning: अथ यत् सूक्त वाके यजमानस्य नाम न गृह्णाति |

sanskrit_iast: atha yat patnī samyājair na caranti |
meaning: अथ यत् पत्नी सम्याजैर् न चरन्ति |

sanskrit_iast: atha yad udañcaḥ paretya tryambakaiś caranti |
meaning: अथ यद् उदञ्चः परेत्य त्र्यम्बकैश् चरन्ति |

sanskrit_iast: rudram eva tat svāyām diśi prīṇanti |
meaning: रुद्रम् एव तत् स्वायाम् दिशि प्रीणन्ति |

sanskrit_iast: atho dakṣiṇā saṃstho vai pitṛ yajñaḥ |
meaning: अथो दक्षिणा संस्थो वै पितृ यज्ञः |

sanskrit_iast: tam eva etad udak saṃstham kurvanti |
meaning: तम् एव एतद् उदक् संस्थम् कुर्वन्ति |

sanskrit_iast: atha yad antata iṣṭvā iṣṭyā yajate |
meaning: अथ यद् अन्तत इष्ट्वा इष्ट्या यजते |

sanskrit_iast: tathā ha asya pūrva pakṣe sākamedhair iṣṭam bhavati |
meaning: तथा ह अस्य पूर्व पक्षे साकमेधैर् इष्टम् भवति |

sanskrit_iast: trayodaśam vā etan māsam āpnoti yat śunāsīryeṇa yajate |
meaning: त्रयोदशम् वा एतन् मासम् आप्नोति यत् शुनासीर्येण यजते |
text:
He obtains the thirteenth month in that he sacrifices with the
Śunāsīrya sacrifice; so great is the year as the thirteenth month; in that there is the thirteenth month, verily thus here is the whole year obtained. If the fire is kindled, the model is the framework of the Vaiśvadeva; if it is not kindled, then the model is the full moon sacrifice; the full moon sacrifice is a support; verily (it serves) for support. In that the fire is kindled, the explanation of that has been given. In that there are seventeen kindling verses, the butter portions contain the word 'being', and the invitatory and offering verses are Virāj verses, the explanation of that has been given. In that there are nine fore-offerings, nine after-offerings, eight oblations and the Sviṣṭakṛt as the ninth, thus he attains the brilliance of the Nakṣatras. The five accompanying oblations ending with that for Pūṣan are the same; the explanation of them has been given. In that he sacrifices to Śunāsīrau, and Śunāsīrau are healing and medicine, verily thus at the end in the sacrifice are healing and medicine produced. In that he sacrifices to Vāyu, and Vāyu is breath, verily thus he delights breath. In that there is (a cake) on one potsherd for Sūrya, and he yonder that gives heat is Sūrya, verily thus he delights him. In that the sacrificial fee is a white (cow ), verily thus he delights him; verily thus is his form produced.

sanskrit_iast: etāvān vai saṃvatsaro yad eṣa trayodaśo māsaḥ |
meaning: एतावान् वै संवत्सरो यद् एष त्रयोदशो मासः |

sanskrit_iast: tad atra eva sarvaḥ saṃvatsara āpto bhavati |
meaning: तद् अत्र एव सर्वः संवत्सर आप्तो भवति |

sanskrit_iast: śāntir eva eṣā bheṣajam antato yajñe kriyate |
meaning: शान्तिर् एव एषा भेषजम् अन्ततो यज्ञे क्रियते |

sanskrit_iast: sa yady agnir mathyate yad vaiśvadevasya tantram tat tantram |
meaning: स यद्य् अग्निर् मथ्यते यद् वैश्वदेवस्य तन्त्रम् तत् तन्त्रम् |

sanskrit_iast: yady u na mathyate paurṇamāsam eva tantram bhavati |
meaning: यद्य् उ न मथ्यते पौर्णमासम् एव तन्त्रम् भवति |

sanskrit_iast: atha yat saptadaśa sāmidhenyaḥ sadvantāv ājya bhāgau virājau samyājye tasya uktam brāhmaṇam |
meaning: अथ यत् सप्तदश सामिधेन्यः सद्वन्ताव् आज्य भागौ विराजौ सम्याज्ये तस्य उक्तम् ब्राह्मणम् |

sanskrit_iast: atha yan nava prayājā nava anuyājā aṣṭau havīṃṣi sviṣṭakṛn navamaḥ |
meaning: अथ यन् नव प्रयाजा नव अनुयाजा अष्टौ हवींषि स्विष्टकृन् नवमः |

sanskrit_iast: samānāni tv eva pañca saṃcarāṇi havīṃṣi bhavanti pauṣṇa antāi vaiśvadekikāni |
meaning: समानानि त्व् एव पञ्च संचराणि हवींषि भवन्ति पौष्ण अन्ताइ वैश्वदेकिकानि |

sanskrit_iast: asau vai sūryo yo asau tapati |
meaning: असौ वै सूर्यो यो असौ तपति |

sanskrit_iast: atha yat prāyaś citta pratinidhīn kurvanti yad āhutīr juhvati |
meaning: अथ यत् प्रायश् चित्त प्रतिनिधीन् कुर्वन्ति यद् आहुतीर् जुह्वति |
text: In that they perform the expiations and the substitutions, in that they offer the libations, verily thus do they produce a benediction, for the healing of the sacrifice and the medicine of the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: atha yat svair agnibhir yajamānam saṃskurvanti |
meaning: अथ यत् स्वैर् अग्निभिर् यजमानम् संस्कुर्वन्ति |
text: In that they lay to rest the sacrificer with his own fires, and the fires are a chariot of the gods, verily thus they lay him to rest on a chariot of the gods; he with this chariot of the gods goes to the world of heaven, where is the world of those who do good.

sanskrit_iast: deva ratha eva enam tat samāropayanti |
meaning: देव रथ एव एनम् तत् समारोपयन्ति |

sanskrit_iast: sa etena deva rathena svargaṃl lokam eti |
meaning: स एतेन देव रथेन स्वर्गंल् लोकम् एति |

sanskrit_iast: sukṛtām yatra lokaḥ sukṛtām yatra lokaḥ |
meaning: सुकृताम् यत्र लोकः सुकृताम् यत्र लोकः |

text: Prajāpati, being desirous of propagation, underwent penance; from him when heated were born five, Agni, Vāyu, Āditya, Candramas, and Uṣas as fifth. He said to them, ‘Do ye also practise fervour.’ They consecrated themselves; then when they had consecrated themselves and had acquired fervour, Uṣas, offspring of Prajāpati, taking the form of an Apsaras, came out in front of them; to her their minds inclined; they poured out seed; they went to Prajāpati, their father, and said, ‘We have poured out seed; let it not remain here ’. Prajāpati made a golden bowl, an arrow breadth in height and similar in breadth; in it he poured the seed; then arose he of a thousand eyes, of a thousand feet, with a thousand fitted (arrows).

sanskrit_iast: aghir vāyur ādityaś candramā uṣāḥ pañcamī |
meaning: अघिर् वायुर् आदित्यश् चन्द्रमा उषाः पञ्चमी |

sanskrit_iast: tān abravīd yūyam api tapyadhvam iti |
meaning: तान् अब्रवीद् यूयम् अपि तप्यध्वम् इति |

sanskrit_iast: tān dīkṣitāṃs tepānān uṣāḥ prājāpatya apsaro rupam kṛtvā purastāt pratyudait |
meaning: तान् दीक्षितांस् तेपानान् उषाः प्राजापत्य अप्सरो रुपम् कृत्वा पुरस्तात् प्रत्युदैत् |

sanskrit_iast: reto vā asicāmahai tan no māmuyā bhūd iti |
meaning: रेतो वा असिचामहै तन् नो मामुया भूद् इति |

sanskrit_iast: sa prajāpatir hiraṇmayam camasam akarod iṣu mātram ūrdhvam evam tiryañcam |
meaning: स प्रजापतिर् हिरण्मयम् चमसम् अकरोद् इषु मात्रम् ऊर्ध्वम् एवम् तिर्यञ्चम् |

sanskrit_iast: tata udatiṣṭhat sahasra akṣaḥ sahasra pāt |
meaning: तत उदतिष्ठत् सहस्र अक्षः सहस्र पात् |

text: He grasped his father Prajāpati; he said to him, ‘Why dost thou grasp me?’ He replied, ‘Give me a name, for without a name assigned I shall not eat food here.’ He answered, ‘Thou art Bhava.’ Since the waters are Bhava, thereby Bhava harms him not, nor his offspring, nor his cattle, nor any one claiming to be his. He who hates him becomes worse, not he who knows thus; his vow is ‘A wet garment should one wear.’

sanskrit_iast: tam abravīt kathā mā abhyāyacchasi iti |
meaning: तम् अब्रवीत् कथा मा अभ्यायच्छसि इति |

sanskrit_iast: na vā idam avihitena nāmnā annam atsyāmi iti |
meaning: न वा इदम् अविहितेन नाम्ना अन्नम् अत्स्यामि इति |

sanskrit_iast: sa vai tvam ity abravīd bhava eva iti |
meaning: स वै त्वम् इत्य् अब्रवीद् भव एव इति |

sanskrit_iast: na ha vā enam bhavo hinasti |
meaning: न ह वा एनम् भवो हिनस्ति |

sanskrit_iast: na asya prajām na asya paśūn na asya bruvāṇam cana |
meaning: न अस्य प्रजाम् न अस्य पशून् न अस्य ब्रुवाणम् चन |

sanskrit_iast: tasya vratam ārdram eva vāsaḥ paridadhīta āpo vai na paricakṣīta iti |
meaning: तस्य व्रतम् आर्द्रम् एव वासः परिदधीत आपो वै न परिचक्षीत इति |

text: A second time he grasped him; he said to him, ‘Why dost thou grasp me?’ He replied, ‘Give me a second name, for with one name only I shall not eat food here.’ He answered, ‘Thou art Śarva.’ Since the fire is Śarva, thereby Śarva harms him not, nor his offspring, nor his cattle nor any one claiming to be his. He who hates him becomes worse, not he who knows thus. His vow is ‘All (sarva ) one should not eat.’

sanskrit_iast: tam abravīt kathā mā abhyāyacchasi iti |
meaning: तम् अब्रवीत् कथा मा अभ्यायच्छसि इति |

sanskrit_iast: na vā idam ekena nāmnā annam atsyāmi iti |
meaning: न वा इदम् एकेन नाम्ना अन्नम् अत्स्यामि इति |

sanskrit_iast: sa vai tvam ity abravīt śarva eva iti |
meaning: स वै त्वम् इत्य् अब्रवीत् शर्व एव इति |

sanskrit_iast: na ha vā enam śarvo hinasti |
meaning: न ह वा एनम् शर्वो हिनस्ति |

text: A third time he grasped him; he said to him, ‘Why dost thou grasp me?’ He replied, ‘Give me a third name, for with two names only I shall not eat food here. He answered, ‘Thou art the lord of cattle.’ Since Vāyu is the lord of cattle, the lord of cattle harms him not, nor his offspring, nor his cattle, nor any one claiming to be his. He who hates him becomes worse, not he who knows thus. His vow is ‘One should not speak ill of a Brahman.’

sanskrit_iast: tam abravīt kathā mā abhyāyacchasi iti |
meaning: तम् अब्रवीत् कथा मा अभ्यायच्छसि इति |

meaning: तृतीयम् मे नाम कुर्व् इत्य् अब्रवीत् |

sanskrit_iast: na vā idam dvābhyām nāmabhyām annam atsyāmi iti |
meaning: न वा इदम् द्वाभ्याम् नामभ्याम् अन्नम् अत्स्यामि इति |

sanskrit_iast: sa vai tvam ity abravīt paśu patir eva iti |
meaning: स वै त्वम् इत्य् अब्रवीत् पशु पतिर् एव इति |

sanskrit_iast: na ha vā enam paśu patir hinasti |
meaning: न ह वा एनम् पशु पतिर् हिनस्ति |

text: A fourth time he grasped him; he said to him, ‘Why dost thou grasp me?’ He replied, ‘Give me a fourth name, for with three names only I shall not eat food here.’ He answered, ‘Thou art the dread god.’ Since the plants and trees are the dread god, thereby the dread god harms him not, nor his offspring, nor his cattle, nor any one claiming to be his. He who hates him becomes worse, not he who knows thus. His vow is ‘One should not look at the cavity of a woman.’

sanskrit_iast: tam abravīt kathā mā abhyāyacchasi iti |
meaning: तम् अब्रवीत् कथा मा अभ्यायच्छसि इति |

sanskrit_iast: caturtham me nāma kurv ity abravīt |
meaning: चतुर्थम् मे नाम कुर्व् इत्य् अब्रवीत् |

sanskrit_iast: na vā idam tribhir nāmabhir annam atsyāmi iti |
meaning: न वा इदम् त्रिभिर् नामभिर् अन्नम् अत्स्यामि इति |

sanskrit_iast: sa vai tvam ity abravīd ugra eva deva iti |
meaning: स वै त्वम् इत्य् अब्रवीद् उग्र एव देव इति |

sanskrit_iast: yad ugro deva oṣadhayo vanaspatayas tena |
meaning: यद् उग्रो देव ओषधयो वनस्पतयस् तेन |

meaning: न अस्य प्रजाम् न अस्य पशून् न अस्य ब्रुवाणम् चन |

sanskrit_iast: tasya vratam striyā eva vivaram na īkṣeta iti |
meaning: तस्य व्रतम् स्त्रिया एव विवरम् न ईक्षेत इति |

text: A fifth time he grasped him; he said to him, ‘Why dost thou grasp me?’ He replied, ‘Give me a fifth name, for with four names only I shall not eat food here.’ He answered, ‘Thou art the great god.’ Since the sun is the great god, thereby the great god harms him not, nor his offspring, nor his cattle, nor any one claiming to be his. He who hates him becomes worse, not he who knows thus. His vow is ‘One should not look at him on his rising or on his setting.’

sanskrit_iast: tam abravīt kathā mā abhyāyacchasi iti |

meaning: न वा इदम् चतुर्भिर् नामभिर् अन्नम् अत्स्यामि इति |

sanskrit_iast: sa vai tvam ity abravīn mahān eva deva iti |

sanskrit_iast: na ha vā enam mahān devo hinasti |

meaning: न अस्य प्रजाम् न अस्य पशून् न अस्य ब्रुवाणम् चन |

meaning: तस्य व्रतम् उद्यन्तम् एव एनम् न ईक्षेत अस्तम् यन्तम् च इति |

text: A sixth time he grasped him; he said to him, ‘Why doest thou grasp me?’ He replied, ‘Give me a sixth name, for with five names only I shall not eat food here.’ He answered, ‘Thou art Rudra.’ Since the moon is Rudra, thereby Rudra harms him not, nor his offspring, nor his cattle, nor any one claiming to be his. He who hates him becomes worse, not he who knows thus. His vow is ‘What is deformed one should not eat, nor the narrow.’

sanskrit_iast: tam abravīt kathā mā abhyāyacchasi iti |
meaning: तम् अब्रवीत् कथा मा अभ्यायच्छसि इति |

sanskrit_iast: ṣaṣṭham me nāma kurv ity abravīt |
meaning: षष्ठम् मे नाम कुर्व् इत्य् अब्रवीत् |

sanskrit_iast: na vā idam pañcabhir nāmabhir annam atsyāmi iti |
meaning: न वा इदम् पञ्चभिर् नामभिर् अन्नम् अत्स्यामि इति |

sanskrit_iast: sa vai tvam ity abravīd rudra eva iti |

He who hates him becomes worse, not he who knows thus. His vow is ‘One should not repulse one who desires food only.’

sanskrit_iast: tam abravīt kathā mā abhyāyacchasi iti |
meaning: तम् अब्रवीत् कथा मा अभ्यायच्छसि इति |

sanskrit_iast: na vā idam ṣaḍbhir nāmabhir annam atsyāmi iti |
meaning: न वा इदम् षड्भिर् नामभिर् अन्नम् अत्स्यामि इति |

sanskrit_iast: sa vai tvam ity abravīd īśāna eva iti |
meaning: स वै त्वम् इत्य् अब्रवीद् ईशान एव इति |

sanskrit_iast: na ha vā enam īśāno hinasti |
meaning: न ह वा एनम् ईशानो हिनस्ति |

sanskrit_iast: na asya prajām na asya paśūn na asya bruvāṇam cana |
meaning: न अस्य प्रजाम् न अस्य पशून् न अस्य ब्रुवाणम् चन |

text:
An eighth time he grasped him; he said to him, ‘Why dost thou grasp me?’ He replied, ‘Give me an eighth name, for with seven names only I shall not eat food here.’ He answered, ‘Thou art the thunderbolt.’ Since Indra is the thunderbolt, thereby the thunderbolt harms him not, nor his offspring, nor his cattle, nor any one claiming to be his. He who hates
him becomes worse, not he who knows thus. His vow is ‘Let him speak truth only, and let him bear gold.’ This is the great god of eight names, distributed eightfold; up to the eighth generation his offspring eats food; ever more brilliant is a son born in the offspring of him who knows thus.
